purpose: Define the Hero-detail usable-Soldier block as a presentation projection of the validated shared Hero-Soldier Relation Layer. Stage 5-3 must consume canonical relations and must never recalculate membership from ConfigData.

ownership.heroPage: May consume byHeroId and join Soldier Master presentation metadata only.
forbidden: Infer Normal/SP identity by numeric offsets
Join by Hero or Soldier names

recordShape.soldiers: ordered array of Soldier presentation records

generationRules: Iterate canonical Hero Master records, not byHeroId keys, so every canonical Hero receives exactly one page-block record.
Join each soldierId to Soldier Master by exact soldierId equality.
Preserve every canonical relation; Stage 5-3-4 performs no tier/SP/UI filtering.
Preserve byHeroId soldier ordering, which is deterministic soldierId ascending under the shared index contract.
Do not synthesize a Korean name when nameKr is null; retain nameKrStatus and validationStatus for later presentation/QA policy.
A missing/unknown Soldier ID, duplicate canonical key, duplicate Soldier ID within one Hero list, relation-set blob mismatch or non-PASS shared relation validation is a hard failure.
Pending Korean display metadata is REVIEW only and must not delete a valid relation.
completion: Stage 5-3-4 is complete when one Soldier block is generated for every canonical Hero, every canonical by-Hero relation is preserved exactly once, every referenced soldierId resolves to Soldier Master, and structural validation has no hard errors.
